_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 38 recent 12h windows moving ±2+ points, this is a statistically locked coil — HOLD is the honest base case until the analyst's named breakers (fed_liquidity pivot, short-covering impulse, or dvol convexity expansion) actually fire to release the compression.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst leans UP on low conviction citing potential breakers while the narrative implies UP with higher confidence; the judge overrides both with HOLD as the coil-respecting default
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.01% with spot ETF inflows sustaining and DXY breaking below 99.0
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC funding turns negative with exchange netflow rising above 60 and MVRV_zscore dropping below 15
